official_definition: At the end of the battle, by destroying this Spirit, summon a Cost X Spirit card in the same family as this Spirit from your Hand, without paying it's cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Summon Bolt] or [Summon Bolt: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Summon Bolt]", "give [Summon Bolt]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
